facts.business: India Home Loan Limited is a Housing Finance Company (HFC) engaged in providing housing loans and loans against property, operating under RBI/NHB regulations.

auditor.name: H. K. Shah & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualification: The company is in the process of implementation of an NBFC industry-specific ERP software which is yet to be implemented for strengthening the internal controls. Emphasis of Matters: 1) Even though the going-concern view of the company is improving, the revenue needs to be further increased. 2) To mitigate the risk on financial assets, the company possesses collaterals, wherever required as per the powers conferred on the HFC under the SARFESI Act. Any surplus funds are returned to the customers. As a result of this practice, the properties under legal repossessions are treated as assets held for sales.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Principal Business Criteria for HFC classification (housing finance at 42.37% and housing finance to individuals at 41.68% of total assets vs required 60% and 50%)
Default on repayment of NCDs aggregating Rs. 20 Crores due June 30, 2023; outstanding liability Rs. 24.03 crore as of March 31, 2026
RBI monetary penalty of Rs. 32,000 for non-compliance with KYC Directions, 2016
Qualification on internal controls due to pending implementation of NBFC industry-specific ERP software (Graviton)
Secretarial observation on delayed process for Managing Director continuation approval after attaining age 70
Going concern concern highlighted by auditor: revenue needs to be further increased
Impact of COVID-19 on credit loss estimates and economic uncertainty
